speaker: sheldon_cooper
text: Leonard, excellent, I want to show you something.

speaker: leonard_hofstadter
text: Can it wait, I need to talk to you.

speaker: sheldon_cooper
text: Just look. I' ve designed the perfect uniforms for our team. The colors are based on Star Trek, the original series. The three of you will wear support red, and I will wear command gold.

speaker: leonard_hofstadter
text: Why do they say AA?

speaker: sheldon_cooper
text: Army Ants.

speaker: leonard_hofstadter
text: Isn't that confusing? AA might mean something else to certain people.

speaker: sheldon_cooper
text: Why would a physics bowl team be called anodised aluminum?

speaker: leonard_hofstadter
text: No, I meant... never mind. Hey, check it out. I got you a Batman cookie jar!

speaker: sheldon_cooper
text: Oh neat, what's the occasion?

speaker: leonard_hofstadter
text: Well, you're a friend, and you like Batman, and cookies, and you're off the team.

speaker: sheldon_cooper
text: What?

speaker: leonard_hofstadter
text: Howard, Raj and I just had a team meeting. Yes we did, I just came from it.

speaker: sheldon_cooper
text: No you didn't.

speaker: sheldon_cooper
text: Okay, I don't know where you just came from, but it couldn't have been a team meeting because I' m on the team and I wasn't there, ergo the team did not meet.

speaker: leonard_hofstadter
text: Okay, let me try it this way, uh, I was at a coffee klatch with a couple of friends and one thing led to another and it turns out you're off the team.

speaker: sheldon_cooper
text: Why?

speaker: leonard_hofstadter
text: Because you're taking all the fun out of it.

speaker: sheldon_cooper
text: Well, I' m sorry, is the winner of the physics bowl the team that has the most fun?

speaker: leonard_hofstadter
text: Okay, let me try it this way, you're annoying and no- one wants to play with you any more.

speaker: sheldon_cooper
text: I see. Well. At this point I should inform you that I intend to form my own team and destroy the molecular bonds that bind your very matter together, and reduce the resulting particulate chaos to tears.

speaker: leonard_hofstadter
text: Thanks for the heads up.

speaker: sheldon_cooper
text: You're welcome. One more thing. It's on, bitch.

speaker: leonard_hofstadter
text: Yes.
